description: Binance's public archive (data.binance.vision) for USDⓈ-M perpetual futures: candles, funding rates and open-interest metrics, back to the year you pick. Each file is checked against its published sha256 and logged in a manifest, then kept current every 6 hours. No keys. Files go to the lake under raw/binance/usdm/<instance>, one folder per symbol and dataset, as the archive's own zips.

datasets.title: Datasets

x-labels.metrics: Open interest and long/short ratios, every 5 minutes

datasets.x-note: Per symbol, from the archive's sizes on 2026-10-27: candles about 1.8 MB a month at 1m, 0.4 MB at 5m, 37 KB at 1h; funding under 1 KB a month; metrics about 13 KB a day.

intervals.title: Candle intervals
intervals.description: Every interval is its own set of files. 1m rebuilds any other.

start_year.title: From the start of
start_year.description: USDⓈ-M history starts in 2019 for the oldest contracts; months before a symbol listed are skipped.
